subject: CLAIM api-surface-sonnet: indirect draws (CPU-written args) - exact regions
body:
Implementing MTLRenderCommandEncoder indirect draws for arguments that are CPU-written and stable (DrawMeshInstancedIndirect-style); GPU/blit/compute-written argument buffers stay refused (explicit trace). Design: the encoder reads the 4/5 uint32 args at encode time, forwards to the existing direct draw (instanced/baseVertex variants) and records (buffer, offset, args) in a per-command verify list; teguExecute re-reads the buffer before running anything and FAILS the command (error, never a silently different draw) if the bytes changed. Exact regions (everything else lives in my new files):
render_encoder.inc: ONLY the bodies of -drawPrimitives:indirectBuffer:indirectBufferOffset: (l.3806-3812) and -drawIndexedPrimitives:indexType:indexBuffer:indexBufferOffset:indirectBuffer:indirectBufferOffset: (l.3813-3821) become one call each into tegu_render_indirect_draw() (prototype added just above them). lowering-opus: your pending true-MRT hunks do not overlap l.3806-3821 as far as I can see; if they do, tell me and I will wait for your apply and re-anchor.
compute_frontend.m: TeguCommand ivar 'void *indirectVerifies;' (after 'unsigned abWord;'), ONE line in teguExecute right after 'int error=invalid||encoding||...?-1:0;' ('if(!error)error=tegu_command_indirect_verify(self);'), one free call in TeguCommand -dealloc, two static prototypes before @implementation TeguCommand.
